data.body: Fixed on main (f222a215ee, via story 0cd7 DD8): build-integration-diff.sh build_net_integration_diff now uses git diff-tree --cc for merge commits (>=2 parents) so a conflict-resolution merge's real delta is surfaced as touched files. Previously plain diff-tree emitted 0 files for a merge -> empty net diff -> dispatcher false-tripped its empty-net-diff fail-closed. Regression tests T8 (content-bearing merge -> non-empty, RED before fix) + T9 (clean merge stays empty) in test-build-integration-diff.sh (9/9).
